data_fields.name: npcKillExpPct
data_fields.donor_constant: NPC kill-exp modifier percent; applied when >= 0

data_fields.name: groupMemberEXPStep
data_fields.donor_constant: RuleR GroupMemberEXPModifier (value not read): group modifier 1 + step*(n-1) for 2-5 members

data_fields.name: fullGroupEXPModifier
data_fields.donor_constant: RuleR FullGroupEXPModifier (value not read), used at 6 members

data_fields.name: groupExpMultiplier
data_fields.donor_constant: RuleR GroupExpMultiplier (value not read), pool bonus for 2-6 members when rule enabled

data_fields.name: levelGapAllowanceFraction
data_fields.donor_constant: floor(1.5*m) - m, equal to floor(m/2) for whole levels

data_fields.name: maxExpLevelRule
data_fields.donor_constant: RuleI Character MaxExpLevel, plus one (value not read)

data_fields.name: perKillPercentCap
data_fields.donor_constant: RuleI ExperiencePercentCapPerKill (value not read); gain capped at floor(span * cap/100)

data_fields.name: hotZoneBonus
data_fields.donor_constant: RuleR Zone HotZoneBonus (value not read), additive on total modifier

best_idea: Split a group kill's pool equally over the whole group, skip any member more than max(5, level/2) levels below the highest member, and cap each member's payout at a per-level formula, so a low-level member cannot take a large share of a high-level kill.
decision_why: Frankendom's many-on-one fights need a level-gap gate and a per-member cap; we take both as data fields, and we do not take the donor's silent loss of an excluded member's share, which breaks the one-ledger rule unless Frankendom shows it in the fight record.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a grouped kill by three players pays each member no more than (level + 3)^2 x 262.5, that a member more than max(5, level/2) levels below the highest member is paid nothing, and that a grey kill pays nobody.
